· RSI trajectory (77.8→80.4) + continuing overbought entry · MACD histogram trajectory (0.0212→0.0556) + improvement holding, bullish expansion signal · Bollinger Band current price position (approaching upper band $1.55) + 70.33% band width indicating increased volatility.
